full_name: Susan Moffitt | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Social Sciences Hrdy Fellow Brown University
bio: Susan Moffitt is the Mary Tefft and John Hazen White Sr. Assistant Professor of Political Science and Public Policy at Brown University. Her research interests are in the fields of American political institutions and public policy, with particular emphasis on developing the capacity to implement policy in the fields of public education and public health.
